description: Convert Unix file permissions between octal (755, 0644, 4755), symbolic (rwxr-xr-x, ls -l style -rwsr-xr-x) and chmod clauses (u=rwx,g=rx,o=; relative ones like g+w or +x apply to "base"). Returns all forms, a plain-English description per owner/group/others, setuid/setgid/sticky meaning, safety warnings, and ready chmod commands. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/chmod-calc/

base.description: Starting mode (octal) for relative clauses like "g+w". Default 000.

file.description: File name for the example chmod commands (shell-quoted).

name: chmod_calc
title: chmod calculator
